routes.reason: Permanent catalog deletion excluded; update_inventory_location active=false retains history and provides the recoverable business operation.
Owned by finance MCP scale_invoice_budget; no duplicate tool registration.
Decision requires the external counterparty session; agency MCP may publish deliveries and inspect approval state but never impersonates client acceptance.
Deletion can physically remove unused stages; update_pipeline_stage active=false is exposed instead with canonical last-open-stage guard.
External customer acceptance must use the customer public session/link; agency MCP must not impersonate the counterparty.
Public customer token routes are not tenant agency operations; get_budget returns the authenticated document.
Use authenticated budget PDF metadata operation; no bearer public token or arbitrary URL input.

Canonical suite does not implement single-lead GET (it returns the collection); list_leads paginates actual rows instead of inventing a detail operation.

Piece checklist API stores completion timestamps, not independent daily snapshots. For a dated checklist use create_task with due_date, project_id and checklist, then list_tasks from/to or bucket=today.
